summary: Listed as a Corkscrew lookout in Lee County; no other source found. No build, design or site description found.
notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Eastern US Lookouts page gives only the name and Lee County. Two web searches found nothing about this tower. A 2017 News-Press article, Their watch has ended: Lee County fire towers relics of past, is linked from the NHLR Orange River page and returned HTTP 403 when fetched; it may describe the county's towers and should be checked by hand. Do not confuse this site with the NHLR Orange River Lookout Tower (US 1781, FL 26; Lee County; 100 ft Aermotor; built 1961; 26.695770 N, 81.777026 W), which has its own story. Corkscrew does not appear in the cached NHLR Florida list or the cached FFLOS and Forest Fire Lookout Association Florida pages. The story is about 30 words, far under the 120-word floor. Recommend leaving the record at status unknown until a Lee County or Florida Forest Service source is found.
